description: Banking industry standards reference for Silver-layer schema compliance

iso_20022.name: ISO 20022
iso_20022.relevance: Primary messaging standard for payments, securities, trade finance
silver_layer_rules: Use structured address fields: street_name, building_number, post_code, town_name, country
Prefer ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes over currency names
Store BIC (ISO 9362) for financial institutions
Store IBAN (ISO 13616) for account numbers
Use ISO 8601 date-time format for all timestamps
Preserve original message ID in lineage fields
debit_credit_indicator must be CRDT or DBIT

fibo.name: FIBO
fibo.relevance: Semantic definitions for banking entities and relationships
silver_layer_rules: Legal entities must have LEI (ISO 17442) as primary identifier
Party type must distinguish individual vs legal entity
Financial instruments must carry ISIN (ISO 6166) or FIGI
Monetary amounts must be stored as NUMERIC with separate currency field

bian.name: BIAN
bian.relevance: Service domain decomposition and capability model for banking
silver_layer_rules: Align table boundaries to BIAN service domains where possible
Each Silver table should map to one primary BIAN service domain
Use BIAN action terms for status codes: Initiate, Update, Execute, Evaluate, Assess

fdx.name: FDX
fdx.relevance: Open finance / open banking API standard (US & global)
silver_layer_rules: Account types: CHECKING, SAVINGS, LOAN, LINEOFCREDIT, INVESTMENT, INSURANCE
Transaction types: DEBIT, CREDIT
Transaction status: PENDING, POSTED

finos_cdm.name: FINOS CDM
finos_cdm.relevance: Capital markets trade and lifecycle events standard

bcbs_239.name: BCBS 239
bcbs_239.full_name: Principles for Effective Risk Data Aggregation and Risk Reporting
bcbs_239.relevance: Data governance and lineage requirements for risk data
silver_layer_rules: Every risk-related record must have data_source, load_ts, and record_hash
SCD Type-2 history must be maintained for risk-relevant dimensions
Data quality status must be captured per record (dq_status)
Full lineage from source system must be preserved in technical envelope

gdpr.name: GDPR
gdpr.relevance: Personal data handling for EU/UK banks
silver_layer_rules: PII fields must be documented in column descriptions with pii=true
Consent status must be captured on the Party entity
Data retention expiry date must be set per entity
Right-to-erasure must be achievable via surrogate key nullification

basel_iii.name: Basel III
basel_iii.relevance: Capital adequacy, liquidity, and leverage requirements
silver_layer_rules: Risk-weighted exposure amounts must be captured
Capital requirement fields must be present on credit/market risk entities
LCR and NSFR liquidity metrics require balance-level data

psd2.name: PSD2
psd2.relevance: Open banking access to accounts and payment initiation in EU/UK
silver_layer_rules: Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) method must be captured on payment
TPP (Third-Party Provider) identifier must be stored on consent/access records
Consent ID must be linked to payment and account access events
